claim_boundary: This label-free twelve-geometry gas-phase oracle compares the current MACE-POLAR zero-field local-jet density JVP with independent two-step omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD response to four geometry-selected exterior point charges per molecule. It evaluates induced MEP and dipole response only. It invokes no continuum, solvent, experimental solvation label, fitting, post-training, fine-tuning, force, PES, or public profile change. A pass cannot make the known nonvariational learned fixed point a common-energy electronic functional; a failure rejects its spatial response for this gate.

disposition.next_gate: Use this broad spatial-response result to admit or reject a separately scalar V0 response candidate; never repair a failed record with a fitted scale or experimental solvation residual.
